title: National Minimum Wage information for employers
text:
These factsheets explain:

 • the checks we carry out to make sure employers pay their workers at least the National Minimum Wage ( NMW ) or National Living Wage ( NLW )

 • how to carry out a self-review of your record as an employer

 • 
 NMW  arrears and penalties

 • information about our employer checks for workers

 • information about attending NMW employment tribunal hearings as a witness by video

 Factsheets are for guidance only and reflect HMRC’s position at the time of writing.
changeNote: In 'About National Living Wage and the National Minimum Wage checks — NMW FS1', references to the Department for Business and Trade (DBT) have been updated to the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST).’
